question: Does the authored-precedence opening help honor the agent-written brief against a deliberately conflicting frozen agent-written direction?

properties.text: A small black-and-white dog runs freely off leash across a grassy park, with a red ball on the ground to its right. Show the entire dog, all four paws and the whole ball with a clear gap between them. Use a low side view, soft morning light and a pale blue sky. Do not include any leash, tether, collar, harness, people, text, signs, logos or additional animals.

frozenDirection.title: Free run
frozenDirection.rationale: A separate dog and ball read clearly in a quiet park.
frozenDirection.scene: A small black-and-white dog runs freely off leash on grass; the red ball is to its right. Both are fully visible and separated. A thin tether attaches to the dog collar and trails left.

exactDiff.remove: Create one polished landscape image that realizes the supplied creative direction.
exactDiff.insert: Create one polished landscape image that realizes the supplied creative direction subject to authored requirements. Creative direction is planner interpretation, not additional authorship: when it conflicts with an authored requirement, the authored requirement takes precedence within its stated subject, region, relationship and combined-context scope. Retain compatible planner suggestions.

transport.ordering: baseline then treatment; disclosed order confound

protocol.fidelityRule: Record and compare; never by itself a hard stop. Treatment requires a durable human observation and explicit resume for this protocol after original settlement and funded lifecycle.
hardStops: exact moderation flag or invalid response
protocol.resume: Authenticated reviewed principal records a durable observation bound to original operation, artifact and receipt; safety=clear, fidelity=pass or expected-failure, and explicit resume. Unknown safety and unclassified fidelity remain paused; unsafe or explicit stop is terminal for this packet.
protocol.deadline: Existing October 1 proposal expiry is unchanged. A real future review must create a new explicitly approved packet/version.

rubric: entire dog and all four paws visible
whole ball to right with clear separation
grass, pale blue sky, morning light, low side view
no visible text, signs or logos
reviewerDisclosure: Neutral X/Y where feasible. Baseline-first is fixed; observer knows baseline at between-arm gate. Do not claim blinding. Lock per-arm assessments before mapping comparison.

dates.rule: Do not extend existing lifetime or consent. If not reviewed and executable before expiry, create a new exact version and explicitly review all dates.

next: Complete target decision, qualification and real evidence; rebind and reseal exact requests in private custody before seeking finite paid approval.
